visual.general_description: Photograph or scan of a twelve-lead electrocardiogram printed on red-gridded paper in two columns of six rows.
visual.detailed_description: Two page-like columns of tracings on pink/red millimetre-style grid paper with slight shading and a vertical fold-like band. The left column holds six rows labeled I, II, III, aVR, aVL and aVF, each starting with a tall rectangular calibration pulse at the left edge. The right column holds six rows labeled V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and V6 (the fifth label is partly illegible), without calibration pulses. In the limb-lead rows the complexes are small relative to the calibration pulse; rows II, III and aVF show small downward deflections and rows I, aVR and aVL show small upward deflections. In the right column V1 is nearly flat with tiny irregular deflections, while V2 to V6 show repeated sharp downward deflections of greater size than the limb leads. The complexes are spaced at similar intervals along each row. No printed patient name, number, date or time is visible.

visual.general_description: Nuclear scintigraphy composite with planar chest and abdomen views, whole-body views and a grid of tomographic slices, all in orange-red colour maps.
visual.detailed_description: The left block holds eight planar images in two columns and four rows: chest anterior and posterior views with orientation text R-Ant-L and L-Post-R, lateral chest views, abdominal anterior and posterior views, and further lateral views, each with a vertical colour bar at the left (black to blue to red to orange to white). Red overlay text with percentages and a ratio appears at the lower right of the two anterior images and is not reliably legible. The upper right holds four whole-body images (two anterior-posterior pairs) on white backgrounds with colour bars showing a body outline with orange-yellow activity in the torso and head. The lower right holds a five-by-five grid of dark tomographic slices with orange-yellow activity patches. Interface text including All Images appears at the bottom left. No panel letters are printed.
